scope: Theorem 4.2 (Finite-volume cotangent bound) of the manuscript “Anticanonical nonvanishing from smooth semipositivity” (preprints/Anticanonical-nonvanishing-from-smooth-semipositivity-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ff5a08aaa3d9ad23), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Z be smooth connected projective over C, let D ≥ 0 be an integral divisor, and suppose that J = −KZ + D has a semipositive singular Hermitian metric hJ with R Z |sD|2 hJ < ∞. If dim Z > 0, then every nonzero real movable class α satisfies µmin,α(TZ) ≥ −D · α. (4.4) For every integer k ≥ 0 and every line bundle M with a nonzero morphism M → (Ω1 Z)⊗k, the line bundle −M + kD (4.5) is pseudoeffective. More generally, if E is a torsion-free subsheaf of rank r > 0 in (Ω1 Z)⊗k, then − det E + krD is pseudoeffective.
